name: bids_worker_insert
details:
INSERT:{public}::((worker_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles_worker pw
  WHERE ((pw.id = auth.uid()) AND (pw.completed_at IS NOT NULL)))))

name: client_update_bids_on_own_jobs
details:
UPDATE:{public}:(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM jobs
  WHERE ((jobs.id = bids.job_id) AND (jobs.client_id = auth.uid())))):
